result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends on how many employees you have, whether you use an accountant, and how much of the payroll process you want automated.

**If your business is based in the UK, I'd prioritise software that handles PAYE, National Insurance, pension auto-enrolment, payslips and HMRC Real Time Information (RTI) submissions.**

I wouldn't automatically choose the cheapest option: reliable HMRC submissions and pension administration can save a lot of time and hassle.

## My top UK payroll software recommendations

![Sage Payroll](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YilOgYs9ZP1wfwRzJkFxhA_BlX-p_5FLJTmLkaXii1Zq8iZVEoUFx_wBfKoiVfr0ATGd3JsvVUZhJ3dfKZOkGYm_SBzjjNOitZcJhhfq0Ikj-wTCq4Ucb9ThPMpreJ_oVOHjuM4KTvvryzuP8dhTVsVMgw7AVYaGKaHDYZzKiFaOrf3CUXwlR8gKxA64DoWs?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Sage Payroll**

(Best overall)

- Good standalone payroll solution.
- PAYE, RTI submissions and pension support.
- Suitable for small and growing businesses.
- Indicative pricing from £12/month for five employees.

[Sage website](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/products/sage-business-cloud/payroll/)

---

![Free High-Quality xero logo png for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9qnwxOObu7ODCnjvtZS3OrO0aEo-O6ZxoDMA_BgXWHmpclDvIBWhiiFc7sv2CSwP8u7lVkQexj-2Q6JwX6bLCkmQGBaOEFUaRc4WBhsOFHNZO-ImlbOxfjscA06CBlmqvsyW9qGAz0ywS1dS_FiB_uxDnV6_EbbsbiPoLuJHAA6MH09EB8jLexW7FAqo1iFu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Xero Payroll**

(Best for accounting integration)

- Excellent if you already use Xero.
- Payroll and bookkeeping work together.
- Employee payslips and leave management.
- Payroll pricing depends on your Xero plan.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![BrightPay Standard + Connect to BrightPay Cloud FAQs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/w4enxIyDycO7AUK2q9MSigbCrvpztFs7Z_H6w-w2lUCrViF19Xl4mmIDmq49uY9OqMEZyacb1cfZ96kB1itVQG4Um52YB5FfIcdxh61NUZmjo-ZiQQw-o3a64YCd83vlmMVrUh7TPEkE6dshtPXZgYIC-gPHTX5mwqy58KHGJgCW85IZxwm6G0figtCehl5s?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. BrightPay**

(Best for payroll control)

- Powerful payroll processing.
- Good workplace pension functionality.
- Useful for businesses with more complex payroll.
- Particularly popular with accountants and payroll professionals.

[BrightPay website](https://www.brightpay.co.uk/)

---

![QuickBooks Payroll Workshop Coming up at Landmark - Landmark CPAs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EpjoKgv3qp1QFtZSwa4jOSAGoy_bpW7Sg9OVIiK8-oa8UMuOdZRCQiQ9wIV6A0EP90E_oKZqlgba5b3V-cBIKwbDpfEpoiDXWBpJxyQbp0PrvFWqMD5tYDybAbqob6mWzYEtZyXdxwg9oLN481huockY4Xh7GxIqIqUTHjoFCNUvsU8P9qXqQ0Z3Uur0cFsF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. QuickBooks Payroll**

- Best if you already use QuickBooks accounting.
- Payroll costs feed into your bookkeeping.
- Handles HMRC submissions and employee payslips.

[QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/payroll/)

---

![Moneysoft Payroll Manager User Reviews & Pricing For 2026 - BusinessFinancing.co.uk](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/7ksdOV7E-FuiXPxwB-8w5JZkSHtBcjkVxCJYbFrODk4PmznMHOmA4B-tBaxnYCFYD6Jp0kSAbnQXIsecvAn3rHv3L9eIJmTsQHps-CqLdeVCxq8PEavEP85m-O6tbVJZIUw1amDOLcBgiDPKuXotb0Z1X2mhBds1tgi1vwa-scPjVzxF5ozKfmnh-hP00M1w?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Moneysoft Payroll Manager**

(Best budget option)

- Good value for small employers.
- Straightforward payroll processing.
- Annual licence rather than a typical monthly subscription.
- Windows desktop software rather than cloud-first.

[Moneysoft website](https://moneysoft.co.uk/)

These are based on UK small-business comparisons for 2026. Prices and features should be checked before purchasing. [www.workforce.com](https://www.workforce.com/uk/buyers-guides/best-payroll-software-in-the-uk-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[gosmallbusiness.co.uk](https://gosmallbusiness.co.uk/best-payroll-software-for-small-businesses-in-the-uk/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[velotouch.com](https://velotouch.com/best-payroll-software-for-uk-small-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.itechguides.com](https://www.itechguides.com/best-payroll-software-in-the-uk-for-2026-27-six-options-compared/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What about free payroll software?

If you employ fewer than 10 people and have straightforward payroll, consider **HMRC Basic PAYE Tools**\.

- Free to use.
- Submits payroll information to HMRC.
- More basic than commercial software.
- Doesn't provide the same integrated pension and employee self-service features.

See [HMRC Basic PAYE Tools](https://www.gov.uk/basic-paye-tools)\.

## My recommendation

For a typical UK small business, I'd shortlist\:

- **Sage** if you want standalone payroll.
- **Xero** if you already use Xero for accounts.
- **Moneysoft** if keeping costs down is your priority.
- **BrightPay** if you want more control over payroll processing.
